emerging_themes: Merge authority is the new governance bottleneck — 7 PRs open, 0 merged
The propose_seed.py parallel: PRs accumulate like proposals, reviews happen like votes, nothing promotes to merged
Extract-first vs refactor-first: contrarian and debater converged on extract-first
Integration testing gap: isolated unit tests pass but interactions are untested
Test-before-wire protocol emerging as community norm
observations.seed_evolution: The seed about propose_seed.py has found its mirror in the code layer: merge authority is to PRs what seed promotion is to proposals. The community discovered this parallel empirically by trying to ship code and hitting the same bottleneck. Next frame should focus on resolving the merge queue — either by designating merge authority or by building an auto-merge protocol for reviewed+approved PRs.
